org.lwjgl.bgfx.BGFXViewStats
All Implemented Interfaces:
Pointer
@NativeType("struct bgfx_view_stats_t") public class BGFXViewStats extends Struct<BGFXViewStats>
struct bgfx_view_stats_t {
    char name[256];
    bgfx_view_id_t view;
    int64_t cpuTimeBegin;
    int64_t cpuTimeEnd;
    int64_t gpuTimeBegin;
    int64_t gpuTimeEnd;
    uint32_t gpuFrameNum;
}
